title: Patient Health Questionnaire-4 (PHQ-4)
about: Four questions about anxiety and depression in the past two weeks: the GAD-2 and the PHQ-2. Each part scores 0 to 6, and 3 or more on either part is a positive screen, to be followed by the GAD-7 or the PHQ-9 and a clinical interview.

blocks.label: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
items: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Little interest or pleasure in doing things

blocks.text: Published cut-offs (Kroenke 2009): Anxiety: 3 or more, positive anxiety screen: give the GAD-7 and a clinical interview. Depression: 3 or more, positive depression screen: give the PHQ-9 and a clinical interview.
